nodes.label: Controls Hint (W A S D Shift to run · click / E to discover)
nodes.norm_label: controls hint (w a s d shift to run · click / e to discover)
nodes.rationale: Adds Shift-to-run and click-to-discover beyond the brief's WASD + E.

nodes.label: #interaction-prompt ('E · Look closer' badge)
nodes.rationale: Hidden by default; toggled by proximity logic in src/main.js.

nodes.label: #message-panel (surprise/message modal)
nodes.rationale: Empty container filled at runtime by the script with station content.

nodes.label: #surprise-counter-pill ('Surprises: 0 / 8')
nodes.rationale: Tracks discovered surprises; total of 8 exceeds the brief's 6 major stations, implying extra sub-station props count as surprises.

nodes.label: Audio Plan (ambient loop, chime, mute toggle)
nodes.norm_label: audio plan (ambient loop, chime, mute toggle)
nodes.rationale: Nice-to-have, not blocking; Phase 6.

nodes.label: Single Content Config File (content.js/json)
nodes.rationale: All station text lives in one config so the user can edit wording later without touching code; holds clearly marked placeholders for personal messages.

nodes.label: Discovery System (proximity prompt + message overlay)
nodes.rationale: Proximity-based trigger ('press E to look closer') rather than precise clicking so exploration feels natural; reusable across all stations.

nodes.label: Dog Companion (follow-AI)
nodes.rationale: Trails behind player at a fixed offset with idle animations; reflects that she loves dogs.

nodes.label: Dream Travel Globe
nodes.rationale: Rotating globe or dioramas for Amazon, Japan (torii), South Indian temple (gopuram), Switzerland, Paris; click shows 'someday we'll go here' placeholder.

nodes.label: Finale (hand-holding, slow dance, personal message)
nodes.rationale: Two stylized avatars hold hands and sway; message panel with user-supplied text; optional particles and 'Happy Birthday' reveal. PG only per content boundaries.

nodes.label: Food Street
nodes.rationale: Stall with prawn curry prop, chili detail, string lights; light fun captions only.

nodes.label: House (Start Point)
nodes.rationale: Cozy house, porch, warm light; subtle atmospheric nod to a future shared home (garden, sunlight, painting wall) — visual only.

nodes.label: Nostalgia Corner (cartoons, movies, music)
nodes.rationale: References Shin-chan/Doraemon/movies/music via colour palettes, silhouettes, TV/reel/vinyl props — never copyrighted likenesses. Optional jukebox prop.

nodes.label: Phased Implementation Plan (Phase 0–9)
nodes.rationale: Strict order: scaffold → character/movement → world geometry → station interactivity → finale → visual polish → audio → QA → content pass → deploy. Brief says prioritise a working walkable version over polish, but the user in practice judged visual realism at every phase (see memory).

nodes.label: Recipient Profile (tone/content reference)
nodes.rationale: Guides mood, palette and what each station represents (sunflowers, dogs, spicy food/prawn curry, cartoons/movies/music, travel dreams, fashion). Explicitly not for literal display.

nodes.label: The Road That Led To Us (transition beat)
nodes.norm_label: the road that led to us (transition beat)
nodes.rationale: Quieter dusk-lit stretch with signposts; mood shift from fun to heartfelt; the 'feeling safe' undertone lives here only as tone.

nodes.label: Sunflower Garden (Getting Ready corner)
nodes.rationale: Visual centerpiece (her favourite flower) plus jewelry stand, glitter vanity with gold/pink sparkle particles, nail polish prop.

nodes.label: Tech Stack: Three.js, static single page, primitive geometry + PBR
nodes.norm_label: tech stack: three.js, static single page, primitive geometry + pbr
nodes.rationale: Vanilla Three.js or R3F; no backend; free/open assets only; avoid custom sculpted character models and copyrighted character likenesses — realism comes from lighting/materials rather than model complexity.

nodes.label: Third-Person Chase Camera
nodes.rationale: Elevated angled soft-follow camera with easing chosen over top-down because the user wants immersion/realism.

nodes.label: WASD Movement & Boundary Collision
nodes.rationale: WASD/arrow keys; soft bounding-box collision is enough; can't walk off map.

nodes.label: World Layout & Station Order
nodes.rationale: One continuous connected map with a road linking 6 stations in fixed order House → Garden → Globe → Nostalgia → Food Street → Road → Finale. Pacing achieved via map scale, not artificial slowdowns.

nodes.label: Built-in Stylized Character (fallback)
nodes.rationale: Used when no character.glb exists; matches the brief's 'approachable low-poly-but-well-lit humanoid placeholder' approach.

nodes.label: Her World — Walkable 3D Birthday Experience (Project Brief)
nodes.norm_label: her world — walkable 3d birthday experience (project brief)
nodes.rationale: Single-page browser 3D gift; recipient explores with WASD and discovers stations tied to things she loves. Designed as a 3–4 minute guided-but-free walk so it feels like a small world, not a slideshow. Target date Oct 13.

nodes.label: index.html — Page Shell & UI Overlay
nodes.rationale: Entry page: canvas container, HUD overlay, loads Google Fonts Cormorant Garamond (serif for messages) + Outfit (sans for hints) per §9 typography, and ./src/main.js as an ES module. Title/subtitle name the recipient 'Kuchii' (Shivani) and show 'Sept 22' — differs from brd.md's Oct 13 target date.

nodes.label: Custom Character Model Instructions (character.glb)
nodes.rationale: Optional drop-in: place public/models/character.glb to replace the default character; suggests Ready Player Me (photo-based avatar) and Mixamo (rigged with walk/idle/dance animations).

nodes.label: Content Boundaries (no intimate content, no private chat quotes)
nodes.norm_label: content boundaries (no intimate content, no private chat quotes)
nodes.rationale: Non-negotiable: only hand-holding and a slow dance depicted; private conversations inform tone only, never displayed; all personal messages written by the user, not invented by the builder.

nodes.label: Placeholder Personal Messages (user writes final copy)
nodes.norm_label: placeholder personal messages (user writes final copy)
nodes.rationale: Builder must not invent deeply personal copy; only light/fun copy for non-emotional stations. Emotional text (travel signs, road signposts, finale) filled by user in Phase 8.

nodes.label: Realistic-Leaning Visual Style (soft PBR, golden-hour lighting)
nodes.norm_label: realistic-leaning visual style (soft pbr, golden-hour lighting)
nodes.rationale: Soft shadows, AO, warm sunset directional light, PBR materials, warm neutrals + soft pink/gold/sunflower yellow/sky blue; explicitly not flat cartoon low-poly. Finale shifts to warmer dusk palette.
